name: Philemon
title: Philemon — Gospel Reconciliation
tagline: Receive him as you would receive me.
purpose: Secure Onesimus’s welcome as a brother, not merely a returned slave.
christ: Paul images Christ’s advocacy; useful brother restored.
spirit: Fellowship of faith becomes effective in love.
